goal: Compare the internalist claim that correctness can outrun all accessible checks against the requirement that meaningful rule-use admit independent criteria. Determine which accessibility and justification conditions, if any, the grammatical argument needs; distinguish an independent criterion from public consensus.
reason: The exact data-relative classification theorem isolates fiber invariance but supplies neither a privileged projection nor normative/epistemic authority. No corpus claim yet attributes that analytical theorem to Wittgenstein. See docs/notes/wittgenstein-criterion-and-correctness.md.
